text: I am 52 and had a stent fitted in January. The cardiologist was straightforward with me and the follow-up has been good so far. Still tired most afternoons but I feel steady and I am walking again.
Hi Maryanne, yes, mine came and went for about two months before anyone took it seriously. Please keep pushing for a referral.
Does anyone know what this is? I am 19 and my chest hurts when I breathe in deeply. It started last week. I have not told my parents yet because I do not want to worry them.

Women presenting with SCAD are routinely young and without the usual risk factors, which is exactly why it gets missed. I have heard from readers whose symptoms were put down to anxiety for years before anyone ordered imaging. That pattern is well documented and it is still happening.

I keep getting told my results are normal but I do not feel normal. Has anyone else had this? Jump to this post What helped me was asking for a copy of the actual report and reading it myself. Worth doing.
Thank you Kentuckygirl. I will try that at the next appointment.
Magnesium cured my palpitations completely within a fortnight. The doctors will not tell you this because there is no money in it. Try 400mg a day and see.

My mother waited eleven hours in A&E with crushing chest pain and was sent home with indigestion tablets. She went back two days later and had already had a heart attack. I am still angry about it and I do not know where to put that.
Six weeks post-op and I walked the whole loop today without stopping. Grateful to everyone on here who said it gets better, because in March I did not believe it.
